title: 3-Day Yoga & Healing Retreat in Ubud, Bali
metaTitle: 3-Day Yoga & Healing Retreat in Ubud, Bali
metaDescription: Book a 3-day yoga and healing retreat in Ubud, Bali with Vinyasa, meditation, Reiki, Balinese and Ayurvedic massage, meals and accommodation.
summary: Move with Vinyasa Flow, settle into meditation, receive Reiki healing and restore with Balinese and Ayurvedic massage—all in one peaceful, beginner-friendly Bali retreat.
intro: This 3-day yoga and healing retreat in Ubud is designed for travellers who want meaningful rest without committing to a long programme or yoga teacher training course.

Your mornings create energy through meditation and breath-led Vinyasa Flow. Your healing sessions invite quiet rest, while Balinese and Ayurvedic massage give the body time to soften after travel and movement. Fresh plant-based meals, an unhurried campus rhythm and free time by the pool complete the experience.

There is no pressure to perform and no need to arrive flexible. The retreat simply gives you a supportive setting to listen to your body, steady your attention and return to your Bali journey feeling refreshed.

curriculum.title: Vinyasa Flow Yoga
curriculum.summary: Breath-led sequences build warmth, mobility, strength and body awareness with options for different experience levels.

curriculum.title: Guided Meditation
curriculum.summary: Morning and evening practices use breath awareness, observation and relaxation to create a calmer inner pace.

curriculum.title: Reiki Healing
curriculum.summary: A quiet, fully clothed wellness session that offers time to rest, receive and step away from outside stimulation.

curriculum.title: Restorative Massage
curriculum.summary: Experience both Balinese and Ayurvedic massage as distinct moments of care across your three-day stay.

fees.note: Both options include the complete yoga, meditation, Reiki, massage and meal programme. Room allocation is subject to availability. Please confirm the final rate, room, retreat inclusions and preferred dates with the booking team before making payment.

options.label: Twin-Shared Room
options.detail: From $250 USD / person. Solo room matching depends on availability.

options.label: Private Room
options.detail: From $400 USD / person. Your own air-conditioned room and attached bathroom.

extras.label: Airport transfer
extras.detail: Available on request for an additional fee

dailySchedule.activity: Rest, settle in or enjoy pool time

dining.text: Breakfast, lunch and dinner are part of the retreat rhythm. Bali Yoga School serves plant-based meals prepared to support yoga practice and comfortable days on campus.

arrival: Airport transfer: Available on request for an additional fee

policies.title: Schedule changes
items: Exact session times may change slightly according to practitioner availability, group needs and campus operations. The core retreat experiences remain included.

policies.title: Wellness disclaimer
items: Reiki … does not replace medical care or promise a specific health outcome.
Massage sessions are wellness experiences, not medical treatments. Please tell the team about pregnancy, allergies, recent surgery, injuries or pressure preferences before your appointment.

policies.title: Dietary requirements
items: Please share allergies, intolerances and dietary requirements before arrival so the kitchen team can confirm what can be accommodated.
